name: Treasure of Nadia
summary: Complete 30+ hour treasure-hunting adventure RPG blending Zelda-like cave exploration, puzzle quests, item crafting, and animated romance scenes.
ranking_rationale: One of the few finished, huge-campaign adult adventure games with real exploration maps and progression loops; loses points only on backtracking and grind.
pros: Massive finished 30+ hour campaign with real map traversal and puzzle dungeons
Overhauled animated 3D scenes vs predecessor Lust Epidemic
Built-in cheat/gallery helpers once completed for scene replay
cons: Significant backtracking across Cape Desperation to craft quest tools

image.alt: Treasure of Nadia logo and brand card

facts.value: Direct sequel to Lust Epidemic, followed by The Genesis Order
